verdict.rationale: Docs clearly cover negative/refund flows (createOrUpdate for negative transactions, createNegation for full negation, and re-creating partial refunds) and state these tie into 'the appropriate tax return', implying liability/filing flow-through without manual journal entries. However, there is no explicit evidence of end-to-end reporting/dashboard reconciliation of negative amounts or independent confirmation that filings reflect refunds automatically without manual fixes. Missing for 10: explicit reporting/dashboard evidence showing negative amounts reflected in liability reports, independent/hands-on confirmation of refund-to-filing flow, and detail on multi-period refund adjustments.
